section.title: Start small. Add as you grow.
section.intro: One simple site to start, with extras you can add now or later. After launch, you only pay for the changes you ask for. Prices in NZD.
section.footnote: Money tight right now? Get in touch anyway. We can split the cost into smaller payments or start with the basics and add to it later.

section.title: From first chat to live site

steps.title: A quick chat
steps.text: A free 20-minute call about your business and what you want the site to do.

steps.title: Design and build
steps.text: I design and build your site, and you see a working preview to give feedback on.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Once you’re happy, it goes live on your domain, with your Google profile connected.

steps.title: Changes when you need them
steps.text: Send me a request whenever something changes. I tell you the price, then do it.

questions.question: Do I own my website?
questions.answer: Yes. Your domain, words and photos are yours. If you ever leave, you get a full copy of your site.

questions.question: Can I change things myself?
questions.answer: Yes, if you add the news editor, you can post news and specials yourself. For anything else, just send me a message and I’ll do it.

questions.question: Why not Wix, Squarespace or WordPress?
questions.answer: They’re fine for some people, but they take your time to set up and maintain, and often end up slow. My sites are custom and fast, and I make the changes for you when you need them.

questions.question: Are there any ongoing costs?
questions.answer: Only your domain name, usually around $30 a year, paid straight to the registrar. Hosting is free and set up in your name, and there’s no monthly fee to me.

questions.question: How do changes work?
questions.answer: Send me what you’d like changed. Small changes are a fixed price; anything bigger gets a quote before I start, so there are no surprises.
